```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in":  (20.0, 12.0, 24.0),     # input pair gm/Id (weak-ish inversion: efficiency + low Vgs for tail headroom)
    "L_in":     (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),        # long L -> large area for 1/f noise
    "itail":    (8e-6, 4e-6, 16e-6),
    "ifold":    (6e-6, 3e-6, 12e-6),    # cascode branch current
    "gmid_ld":  (7.0, 5.0, 12.0),       # PMOS top sources / NMOS bottom mirror (low gm/Id -> low noise contribution)
    "L_ld":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "Lc":       (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # cascode L
    "gmid_bpc": (3.5, 2.5, 6.0),        # PMOS diode setting vbpc (VDD-referenced) -> sets top-source Vsd
    "gmid_bnc": (3.5, 2.5, 6.0),        # NMOS diode setting vbnc -> sets bottom-mirror Vds
    "cout":     (1.0e-12, 0.1e-12, 4e-12),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    itail = p["itail"]; ih = itail / 2; ifold = p["ifold"]; itop = ih + ifold
    Lb = 2.0; gmid_b = 16.0                       # bias / tail nfets: high gm/Id -> small Vdsat for tail headroom
    i_bp, i_bpc, i_bnc = 5e-6, 3e-6, 3e-6

    # ---- bias nfets (mirrors of ibias) ----
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, iref, vds=0.7)
    m5  = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, itail, vds=0.2)
    mb1 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, i_bp, vds=0.8)
    mb2 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, i_bpc, vds=0.5)

    # ---- input pair ----
    vs_tail = 0.2
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], ih, vds=1.0, vsb=vs_tail)

    # ---- PMOS top sources + VDD-referenced diode ----
    m3  = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], itop, vds=0.4)
    mp0 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], i_bp, vds=m3.vgs)
    mp1 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], i_bnc, vds=0.6)

    # ---- PMOS cascodes (bulk = own source) and their bias diode ----
    m6   = lut.size("p", 12.0, p["Lc"], ifold, vds=0.5)
    mpc0 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_bpc"], p["Lc"], i_bpc, vds=None or 0.9)
    vsd_top = mpc0.vgs - m6.vgs

    # ---- NMOS low-voltage cascode mirror ----
    m10  = lut.size("n", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], ifold, vds=0.3)
    m8   = lut.size("n", 12.0, p["Lc"], ifold, vds=0.4, vsb=0.3)
    mnc0 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_bnc"], p["Lc"], i_bnc, vds=0.9)
    vds_bot = mnc0.vgs - m8.vgs

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MB1", "vbp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MP0", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mp0)
    n.dev("MB2", "vbpc", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb2)
    n.dev("MPC0", "vbpc", "vbpc", "vdd", "vdd", mpc0)
    n.dev("MP1", "vbnc", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mp1)
    n.dev("MNC0", "vbnc", "vbnc", "vss", "vss", mnc0)
    # tail + input pair (vinp on the mirror-diode side -> non-inverting)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "fa", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "fb", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    # top sources
    n.dev("M3", "fa", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "fb", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # PMOS cascodes
    n.dev("M6", "xa", "vbpc", "fa", "fa", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "vbpc", "fb", "fb", m6)
    # NMOS cascode mirror (low-voltage: bottom gates on xa)
    n.dev("M8", "xa", "vbnc", "ya", "vss", m8)
    n.dev("M9", "vout", "vbnc", "yb", "vss", m8)
    n.dev("M10", "ya", "xa", "vss", "vss", m10)
    n.dev("M11", "yb", "xa", "vss", "vss", m10)
    n.C("COUT", "vout", "vss", p["cout"])

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    r_up = (m6.gm / m6.gds) * (1.0 / (m3.gds + m1.gds))
    r_dn = (m8.gm / m8.gds) * (1.0 / m10.gds)
    rout = r_up * r_dn / (r_up + r_dn)
    a0 = gm1 * rout
    ctot = cl + p["cout"]
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * ctot)
    c_fold = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m6.cgg + 2 * m6.cdd
    p_fold = m6.gm / (2 * PI * c_fold)
    c_mir = 2 * m10.cgg + m8.cdd
    p_mir = m8.gm / (2 * PI * c_mir)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p_fold)) - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p_mir))
    itot = iref + i_bp + i_bpc + i_bnc + 2 * itop
    kT4 = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300
    n_th = math.sqrt(2 * kT4 * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1 + m10.gm / gm1))
    slew = min(itail, ifold) / ctot
    settle = 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw) + 0.5 / slew
    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(a0),
        "ugbw": ugbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "power": 1.8 * itot,
        "cmrr_db": db(a0) + 10,
        "psrr_db": db(a0),
        "noise_1k": max(n_th, 1.0e-6),
        "swing": 0.6,
        "slew": slew,
        "settle": settle,
        "vsd_top": vsd_top,
        "vds_bot": vds_bot,
    }
```
